Landing.metaDescription: Run your own Navratri event online: a ticketed website, an organizer dashboard, and an offline gate scanner. Razorpay payments, WhatsApp pass delivery, GST invoices.
Landing.heroReassurance: No setup fee. No monthly fee. Two minutes to apply.
Landing.howTitle: Three steps from this page to your first pass sold
Landing.how1Desc: Your organization, your city, how many people you expect each night, and the subdomain you want. Two minutes and one OTP.
Landing.how2Desc: Someone on our team checks the event is real — usually within 1–2 working days. That check is why your buyers trust the pass they receive.
Landing.how3Desc: Website, admin panel and gate scanner are provisioned together. Add your nights, zones and prices, and start selling the same day.
Landing.proofTitle: Built for a nine-night Navratri, not a one-night concert
Landing.proof1Label: Season pass, single night, or any range in between — one pass model covers all of it.
Landing.proof2Label: Gujarati, Hindi and English — on your site, in your dashboard, and on every pass.
Landing.proof3Label: The gate scanner verifies a pass with no internet at all, and still catches a duplicate.
Landing.proof4Label: Our platform fee and the gateway's — quoted separately, never bundled into one number.
Landing.faq1Q: What does it cost to start?
Landing.faq1A: Nothing up front — no setup fee and no monthly fee. ManharEvent takes a 1% platform fee on each pass you sell, and Razorpay charges its own 2% gateway fee. Both appear as separate lines, for you and for the buyer.
Landing.faq2Q: What happens if the internet drops at the gate?
Landing.faq2A: Nothing stops. The scanner downloads the night's full pass list before the gates open and verifies every scan on the phone itself, in under half a second. Check-ins sync back the moment the phone finds a signal.
Landing.faq3Q: Whose customers are these — yours or mine?
Landing.faq3A: Yours. The site runs on your own subdomain with your branding, and every buyer's number and order sits in your admin panel. Export the whole list any time — we never market to your list.
Landing.faq4Q: How soon can my event be live?
Landing.faq4A: Approval usually takes 1–2 working days. Your website, admin panel and scanner access are ready the same hour it is approved — most organizers finish setting up nights, zones and prices inside an hour.
Landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Two minutes to apply. No card, no setup fee, no contract.

Pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Two honest line items. No bundled surprise fees.
Pricing.platformFeeDesc: Covers hosting, support, GST invoicing, and the gate-scanner app — lower than BookMyShow, Insider, and other bundled-fee platforms.
Pricing.gatewayFeeDesc: Razorpay's own transaction fee — separate, unavoidable, and the same no matter which platform you use.
Pricing.comparisonNote: Other platforms bundle both into one number so you can't tell what you're actually paying for. We don't.
Pricing.exampleTitle: What it looks like on a ₹1,000 pass
Pricing.exampleNote: Both fees are shown to the buyer as separate lines at checkout, exactly as they are here.
Pricing.metaTitle: Pricing — 1% platform fee, gateway fee quoted separately
Pricing.metaDescription: ManharEvent charges a 1% platform fee on each Garba pass you sell. Razorpay's 2% gateway fee is quoted separately, never bundled. No setup fee, no monthly fee — see the worked example on a ₹1,000 pass.
Pricing.noFee3: No charge per gate device or staff login
Pricing.noFee4: No lock-in — export your data and leave any time
Pricing.scaleTitle: The same maths at three price points
Pricing.scaleNote: Figures are per pass, straight from the same fee engine that runs checkout. Multiply by the number of passes you expect to sell.
Pricing.pfaq1Q: When does the money reach my bank?
Pricing.pfaq1A: Razorpay settles to your bank account on its standard cycle — usually T+2 working days after the sale. Both fees come off the buyer's payment at the transaction itself, so there is never an invoice from us for you to chase.
Pricing.pfaq2Q: Do I pay the fees, or does the buyer?
Pricing.pfaq2A: As shown above, both fees are added on top of the price you set, so you receive the full pass price. If you would rather absorb them, set your price lower — the buyer simply sees a smaller total.
Pricing.pfaq3A: 18% GST applies to the pass and to both fees. Every order produces a GST invoice with gap-free numbering, and your accountant can export the whole series from the Finance section of your admin panel.
Pricing.pfaq4A: The pass amount goes back to the buyer under the refund policy you set. Our platform fee is returned with it; the gateway's fee is the gateway's call, and we show you exactly what it kept.
Pricing.ctaSubtitle: Approval takes 1–2 working days. There is nothing to pay until you sell your first pass.
